<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/background_primary"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:paddingStart="16dp"
    android:paddingTop="14dp"
    android:paddingEnd="16dp"
    android:paddingBottom="16dp">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        android:orientation="horizontal">

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnBackFromFuelEntry"
            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.Button.OutlinedButton"
            android:layout_width="44dp"
            android:layout_height="44dp"
            android:insetTop="0dp"
            android:insetBottom="0dp"
            android:minWidth="0dp"
            android:padding="0dp"
            android:text=""
            app:cornerRadius="12dp"
            app:icon="@drawable/ic_arrow_back"
            app:iconTint="@color/text_primary"
            app:strokeColor="#22FFFFFF" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_title"
            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
            android:textSize="18sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/tvFuelEntryVehicleName"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="18dp"
        android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
        android:textSize="34sp"
        android:textStyle="bold" />

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/tvFuelEntrySubtitle"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
        android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
        android:textSize="14sp" />

    <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
        app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
        app:cardCornerRadius="20dp"
        app:cardElevation="0dp"
        app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
        app:strokeWidth="1dp">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:padding="16dp">

            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="20dp"
                android:layout_height="20dp"
                android:contentDescription="@null"
                android:src="@drawable/gas_station"
                android:tint="@color/accent_color" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:orientation="vertical">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_profile_card_title"
                    android:textAllCaps="true"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_tertiary"
                    android:textSize="10sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/tvFuelEntryProfileMeta"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="15sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

            </LinearLayout>

        </LinearLayout>

    </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:fillViewport="true">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:paddingBottom="12dp">

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"
                android:letterSpacing="0.08"
                android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_section_main"
                android:textColor="@color/accent_color"
                android:textSize="11sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                app:cardCornerRadius="18dp"
                app:cardElevation="0dp"
                app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
                app:strokeWidth="1dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp">

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                        android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryDate"
                        style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_date"
                        android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                        app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                        app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                        app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                        app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp"
                        app:endIconMode="custom"
                        app:endIconDrawable="@android:drawable/ic_menu_today"
                        app:endIconTint="@color/primary_color">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                            android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryDate"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:background="@null"
                            android:clickable="true"
                            android:cursorVisible="false"
                            android:focusable="false"
                            android:inputType="none"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            android:textSize="15sp" />
                    </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                        android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryStation"
                        style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_station"
                        android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                        app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                        app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                        app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                        app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                            android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryStation"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:background="@null"
                            android:inputType="textCapWords"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            android:textSize="15sp" />
                    </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                        android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryFuelType"
                        style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_fuel_type"
                        android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                        app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                        app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                        app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                        app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                            android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryFuelType"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:background="@null"
                            android:inputType="textCapCharacters"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            android:textSize="15sp" />
                    </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:orientation="horizontal">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                            android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryLitres"
                            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginEnd="6dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_litres"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                            app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                            app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                            app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp"
                            app:suffixText="L">

                            <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                                android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryLitres"
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:background="@null"
                                android:inputType="numberDecimal"
                                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                                android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                                android:textSize="15sp" />
                        </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                            android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryPricePerLitre"
                            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginStart="6dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_price_per_litre"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                            app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                            app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                            app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp"
                            app:suffixText="лв/L">

                            <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                                android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryPricePerLitre"
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:background="@null"
                                android:inputType="numberDecimal"
                                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                                android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                                android:textSize="15sp" />
                        </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                    </LinearLayout>

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:orientation="horizontal">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                            android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryTotalAmount"
                            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginEnd="6dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_total_amount"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                            app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                            app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                            app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp"
                            app:suffixText="лв">

                            <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                                android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryTotalAmount"
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:background="@null"
                                android:inputType="numberDecimal"
                                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                                android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                                android:textSize="15sp" />
                        </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                            android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryOdometer"
                            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginStart="6dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_odometer"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                            app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                            app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                            app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp"
                            app:suffixText="km">

                            <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                                android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryOdometer"
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:background="@null"
                                android:inputType="number"
                                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                                android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                                android:textSize="15sp" />
                        </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                    </LinearLayout>

                </LinearLayout>

            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

            <TextView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginTop="18dp"
                android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"
                android:letterSpacing="0.08"
                android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_section_extra"
                android:textColor="@color/accent_color"
                android:textSize="11sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                app:cardCornerRadius="18dp"
                app:cardElevation="0dp"
                app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
                app:strokeWidth="1dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp">

                    <com.google.android.material.switchmaterial.SwitchMaterial
                        android:id="@+id/switchFuelEntryFullTank"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_full_tank"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                        android:textSize="15sp"
                        app:thumbTint="@color/accent_color"
                        app:trackTint="@color/stroke_dark" />

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                        android:id="@+id/inputFuelEntryNotes"
                        style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.TextInputLayout.OutlinedBox"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:hint="@string/garage_fuel_entry_notes"
                        android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                        app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/dark_surface"
                        app:boxStrokeColor="@color/primary_color"
                        app:boxStrokeWidth="1dp"
                        app:boxStrokeWidthFocused="2dp">

                        <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                            android:id="@+id/etFuelEntryNotes"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:background="@null"
                            android:gravity="top|start"
                            android:inputType="textCapSentences|textMultiLine"
                            android:minLines="3"
                            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                            android:textColorHint="@color/text_tertiary"
                            android:textSize="15sp" />
                    </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                </LinearLayout>

            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        </LinearLayout>

    </ScrollView>

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
        android:orientation="horizontal">

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnCancelFuelEntry"
            style="@style/Widget.MaterialComponents.Button.OutlinedButton"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="52dp"
            android:layout_marginEnd="6dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:insetTop="0dp"
            android:insetBottom="0dp"
            android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_cancel"
            android:textAllCaps="false"
            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
            app:cornerRadius="26dp"
            app:strokeColor="#22FFFFFF" />

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnSaveFuelEntry"
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="52dp"
            android:layout_marginStart="6dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:insetTop="0dp"
            android:insetBottom="0dp"
            android:text="@string/garage_fuel_entry_save"
            android:textAllCaps="false"
            android:textColor="@android:color/white"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            app:backgroundTint="@color/accent_color"
            app:cornerRadius="26dp"
            app:icon="@drawable/gas_station"
            app:iconGravity="textStart"
            app:iconPadding="8dp"
            app:iconTint="@android:color/white" />

    </LinearLayout>

</LinearLayout>
